process: You gave the go for the stretch test on Board 3 (DR-57) and restarted in a new chat. The main session checked the six datasets in a fresh container: all present, nothing pending.

One fix pass worked through a merged list of 9 must-fix and 12 should-fix items.

The statistics reviewer checked its own findings again, and the creative director scored the fixed page and wrote this board's content. The main session added the process, the checks, the next-stage questions and the change log, then built, checked and published the board.

next_questions.q: Rule 05.3's sentence on icons in a row or menu (P3, a named approval).
next_questions.text: Today it reads: “In a row or a menu, icons go one color and only the current one keeps its red.” The proposal ends it: “…and only the current one keeps its red, and that red counts as signature red.” Without the clause, a menu's current icon spends the view's one working red, so a page could not show a menu and an ask button together.

next_questions.q: Five direction review rules, as a set (R7, R9, R10, R11, R13).
next_questions.text: R7 is already V7.1 item 29 and needs only your yes. R9 keeps a pillar mark under 48 px beside its word. R10 makes icons at 16 px one color, with no red. R11 lets a standalone icon's red sit bare on Newsprint as signature red. R13 makes Charcoal the default tile for the app icon and avatars.

next_questions.q: The reader check with real people (Q-13).
next_questions.text: Every test of the marks, atlas cards and charts so far used simulated readers. Five or more people who have never seen the brand would look at one sheet, ten seconds per item, and answer four short questions. The studio can build the sheet as a private page that records their answers, so all you do is send the link.
next_questions.rec: Yes, before Gate 2, with the studio's page.
